hotels.description: Tucked into Apia’s volcanic ridges, Moanalei Villas is a breath of fresh air. This brand-new, all-villa retreat trades the usual resort hum for pure, high-end seclusion. Each sanctuary boasts its own infinity pool, offering a front-row seat to lush island vistas. When hunger strikes, TASI Restaurant delivers island-inspired plates bursting with Samoa's freshest bounty: tropical fruits, volcanic-grown vegetables, sustainable proteins and cocktails that taste like liquid sunshine. Whether you're exploring hidden hiking trails, unwinding poolside, or discovering how Samoans have perfected the art of going slow, Moanalei makes every moment count. Ditch the logistics and lean into the luxury: your stay flows seamlessly with a private driver at your service, plus a dedicated e-concierge just a tap away. From the complimentary mini bar to the in-villa tropical breakfasts, every detail is taken care of. Convenience isn’t just a perk - it’s the standard for every single guest.
